title: betterperf
description: A lightweight Fabric optimization mod for 1.20.1 that improves FPS by culling invisible entities and optimizing AI in mob farms.
body:
## BetterPerf - Simple FPS Boost

BetterPerf is a lightweight optimization mod for Fabric 1.20.1 designed to improve game performance without complex settings.

### Features:
* **Entity Culling:** Automatically hides entities that are not visible to the player, significantly reducing rendering load.
* **AI Optimization:** Thins out AI processing for mobs in large farms and spawners, preventing TPS drops and lag.
* **Plug & Play:** No configuration required—just install and enjoy better FPS.

---
### Русский язык
Легкий Fabric-мод для 1.20.1: отсечение невидимых сущностей и прореживание AI мобов в фермах и на спавнах. Больше FPS без настроек.
